entries.title: Model Context Protocol — Specification (2025-06-18)
entries.note: Defines JSON-RPC 2.0 wire format, hosts/clients/servers, and security/trust principles. Notes that 'MCP itself cannot enforce these security principles at the protocol level' — isolation is the host's responsibility.

entries.title: Nix Reference Manual — Introduction
entries.note: Functional package manager; immutable /nix/store with hash-addressed paths; deterministic derivations.

entries.title: Nix Flakes — nix.dev
entries.note: Inputs/outputs model, flake.lock pinning, still flagged experimental.

entries.title: devenv.sh — Fast, Declarative, Reproducible, and Composable Developer Environments
entries.note: Higher-level wrapper around Nix; ~100ms activation; 50+ language modules; processes/services; SecretSpec integration.

entries.title: devenv.sh — Languages
entries.note: 60+ language toggles including languages.python, languages.javascript, languages.rust with channel/version selectors.

entries.title: devenv.sh — SecretSpec integration
entries.note: Recommends loading secrets at runtime (secretspec run --), not into the shell env.

entries.title: SecretSpec — Declarative secrets, every environment, any provider
entries.note: Separates declaration from storage; providers include keyring, dotenv, env, pass, 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden, AWS/GCP Secrets Manager, Vault/OpenBao.

entries.title: cachix/secretspec — GitHub
entries.note: Reference TOML schema and CLI invocation patterns.

entries.title: Mic92/sops-nix — Atomic secret provisioning for NixOS based on sops
entries.note: Decrypts at activation, supports age/GPG/AWS/GCP/Azure/Vault.

entries.title: ryantm/agenix — age-encrypted secrets for NixOS
entries.note: Uses SSH public keys for encryption, mounts decrypted secrets at /run/agenix/.

entries.title: Pass — The Standard Unix Password Manager
entries.note: GPG-encrypted password files in ~/.password-store; Git history; extensions; libsecret bridge exists.

entries.title: containers/bubblewrap — Unprivileged sandboxing tool
entries.note: Uses Linux user namespaces; --ro-bind, --unshare-pid, --unshare-net, seccomp filter support.

entries.title: Firejail — Linux namespaces sandbox
entries.note: SUID helper, namespaces + seccomp-bpf, profiles shipped for 1,000+ desktop apps.

entries.title: google/nsjail — Lightweight process isolation tool
entries.note: Namespaces + cgroups + rlimits + seccomp-bpf via Kafel; TCP-listener and one-shot modes.

entries.title: A quick glance at macOS' sandbox-exec — Julio Merino
entries.note: Walk-through of SBPL syntax via real Bazel profile; documents stability quirks across macOS versions.

entries.title: Clarify sandbox-exec deprecation timeline (apple/containerization #737)
entries.note: Confirms sandbox-exec is deprecated but still functional, with no published replacement for headless/CLI sandboxing.

entries.title: AppContainer isolation — Win32 apps (Microsoft Learn)
entries.note: Isolation domains: credential, device, file/registry, network, process, window. Capabilities-based access.

entries.title: Public Preview: Improve Win32 app security via app isolation — Windows Developer Blog
entries.note: Two-step model: low-integrity AppContainer launch + capability checks.

entries.title: Docker MCP Toolkit — Docker Docs
entries.note: 1 CPU and 2 GB cap per server; no host FS access by default; secrets blocked in tool I/O.

entries.title: Docker MCP Toolkit: Run MCP Servers Securely — Docker Blog
entries.note: Architecture overview, signed images, profile system.

entries.title: Podman vs Docker rootless containers — DDEV
entries.note: Daemonless model, rootless default, user-namespace UID mapping.

entries.title: uvx — Run Python CLI tools in isolated environments (pydevtools)
entries.note: Ephemeral isolated venvs; ~1s cold, tens-of-ms warm; written in Rust.

entries.title: pipx vs alternatives (uv tool) — pipx docs
entries.note: Both install console scripts on PATH in isolated venvs; pipx unique flags (inject, --global).

entries.title: MCP Horror Stories: The Supply Chain Attack — Docker Blog
entries.note: Documents npx supply-chain risk vector for MCP servers; CVE-2025-6514 (mcp-remote RCE, CVSS 9.6).

entries.title: MCP Server Security: Best Practices & Common Mistakes — Toolradar
entries.note: Pin versions, prefer Docker/Podman, treat npx as 'curl | bash'.

entries.title: GNOME/Keyring — ArchWiki (libsecret, Secret Service D-Bus API)
entries.note: libsecret is the modern client; gnome-keyring and ksecretservice implement the Secret Service D-Bus API.

entries.title: windows-dpapi — crates.io
entries.note: Safe Rust wrapper over Windows Data Protection API; User vs Machine scope.

entries.title: keyring — Rust cross-platform credential store
entries.note: macOS Keychain, Secret Service (libsecret), Windows Credential Manager backends.

entries.title: Vault Agent — HashiCorp Developer
entries.note: Client daemon, auto-auth, template rendering of secrets to disk/env.

entries.title: The Three Difficult Things about Nix — Richard Goulter
entries.note: Documents Nix's tripartite learning burden: language, Nixpkgs internals, system-under-Nix.

entries.title: Documentation Team: Flattening the learning curve — NixOS Discourse
entries.note: Community survey confirming documentation deficits.

entries.title: Announcing SecretSpec: Declarative Secrets Management — devenv blog
entries.note: Origin and motivation for SecretSpec as a devenv-adjacent project.

entries.title: Alcoholless: A Lightweight Security Sandbox for macOS Programs — Akihiro Suda (NTT Labs)
entries.note: Demonstrates wrapping AI/agent tools with sandbox-exec in 2025-era practice.
